release_notes:
FocusShield Engine v1.4.8:
• Complete Micro-Interactions & Transitions: Physical 3D spring mechanical depression (2.5dp displacement) on buttons, touch compression on gauge cards, smooth color fades on YouTube toggle, and spring entrance transitions.
• Today's Study Goal System: Interactive daily target manager (30m, 45m, 60m, 90m presets or custom). Directly editable with real-time progress syncing.
• Live Study Goal Visualizer: Active study screen displays real-time progress bar towards your daily study goal with achievement celebrations.
• Tactile Wrap-up Dialog: Haptic confirmation modal when ending study sessions that automatically records focused minutes into your daily goal.
• Focus Study Mode & YouTube Switch: Clean distraction lock with essential apps allowed (Phone, SMS, Contacts, Clock, Calculator) and YouTube Lecture mode toggle.
